provenance.movement_reasoning: Marie’s mobile work makes the entry floor, entry bowl, dining table, and nearby chair active staging points. Her daily carry returns from service calls in predictable but slightly untidy patterns; the kitchen accumulates mealware until washing resets it. Sofa activities spread reading, tea, blankets, and entertainment items, while bathroom and laundry routines shift towels and grooming items. Tidy-ups restore several objects to their normal homes, but infrequent or conditional uses retain substantial NO_OP mass.
provenance.persona_reasoning: Single-resident gig household centered on a part-time mobile bicycle-repair technician whose work kit and personal items circulate between a compact apartment and changing service calls.
